question: Which of the following was the runners-up at Durand Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai City FC.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Durand Cup is one of the oldest **football tournaments** in the world and the oldest in India.
 
• It's named after its founder, **Sir Mortimer Durand,** who started the tournament in **1888**.
 
• In the 2022 Durand Cup, **Bengaluru FC **emerged as the winner and the runners-up is **Mumbai City FC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__****Durand Cup -**

__
 
• Founded- **1888**
 
• Number of teams: **20**
 
• Organizing body: **Durand Football Tournament Society, and AIFF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Other tournaments related to Football are:-**

 
• Senior NFC (Santosh Trophy)
 
• B.C. Roy Trophy 
 
• Senior Women's National Football Championship
 
• Junior Girl's National Football Championship
 
• Sub–Junior Girl's National Football Championship
